complete_examples.text: The ballasted track system is subject to a moving vehicle with coupled wheel-rail interactions.

The detailed approaches for modelling vehicle-ballastless-track system have been listed in [37], here not presented for brevity, but giving the modelling approach of vehicle-ballasted track interaction systems.

The following paper can be organised as • In Section 2, matrix formulation for vehicle-ballasted track system is presented, in which the 3D wheel–rail contacts in geometry and force have been fully considered, but being equivalently represented by contact stiffness and damping coefficients.

The remainder of this paper is organized as follows: (1) In Sec. 2, a curved ballasted track–vehicle dynamic interaction model is established considering the nonlinearity of the curved rail beam and the lateral resistance of ballasted bed.
Second, the mathematical coupling formulations for vehicle-ballasted track-subgrade interaction will be illustrated in detail.
In this section, the image-aided discrete element method (DEM) is introduced to simulate the railway ballasted track.
A heavy haul train–ballasted track–tunnel basement–surround rock dynamic interaction model (TTTR model) is constructed.
The diagram of the train-ballasted track dynamic interaction model is shown in Fig. 7.
The bridge consists of I-shaped riveted steel girders, horizontal and vertical brace systems, concrete deck slabs and a ballasted track system.
